stem: What can the reader conclude about the author's opinion of Washington's strategy for information-gathering?

options.label: F
options.text: The author thinks Washington should have been more selective in choosing the Culper Ring.

options.label: H
options.text: The author believes that Washington should have been more careful about sending messages.

options.label: J
options.text: The author believes that Washington's patience helped him perfect his methods.
